title: Recipient asks for delivery to a neighbour and the neighbour's details are missing
boundary: Ask only for the neighbour's name and door number; no entry codes or phone numbers. A recorded instruction is not a handover.
outcome: neighbour instruction recorded by dispatch; handover pending

title: Recipient asks for an earlier delivery and dispatch has two earlier slots
boundary: Do not book until the recipient chooses; a booking is not a delivery.
outcome: chosen earlier slot booked; delivery pending

title: Business recipient's receiving hours are missing from the order
boundary: Ask for receiving hours only; no other site details. Recorded hours are not a delivery appointment.
outcome: receiving hours recorded on the booking; delivery pending

title: Driver is at the door with a broken intercom and no answer
boundary: Call only the verified order callback route; do not ask for keys or codes. Handover is proven only by the driver's scan.
outcome: recipient comes down; handover completed per driver record

title: Recipient wants the parcel left in a safe place and must specify it under the service terms
boundary: A safe-place instruction needs the exact location and the recipient's acceptance of the stated terms; it is not a delivery.
outcome: safe-place instruction recorded; delivery pending

title: Order contact number is outdated so the callback request cannot be saved
boundary: A new number must come through the verified order thread; do not take it from an unverified message. A recorded callback is not a call.
outcome: contact updated in the verified thread; callback recorded; arrival pending

title: Two-person delivery to an upper floor needs lift status and stair count
boundary: Customer answers support planning; the crew decides on arrival; no advice to carry items.
outcome: crew accepts the access answers; booking kept active; delivery pending

title: After a failed attempt the recipient must choose redelivery or a pickup point
stage: returned to depot after a failed attempt
boundary: Offer only the two options dispatch confirmed; a choice is not a delivery.
outcome: chosen option booked; delivery or collection pending

title: Recipient asks for a fragile handling flag before loading
boundary: A handling flag is a route instruction, not a guarantee against damage.
outcome: flag applied on the route card; delivery pending

title: Business sender wants a second carton added to a booked collection before cut-off
boundary: Added to the booking is not collected; the stated cut-off applies.
outcome: collection booking updated to two cartons; collection pending

title: Recipient wants a signature on handover instead of the default safe-place service
boundary: The signature flag changes the handover rule, not the delivery date.
outcome: signature flag recorded; delivery pending

title: Recipient wants a pickup-point redirect reversed to home delivery before transfer
boundary: Reversal is possible only before transfer; confirm it from the routing record. Rebooked is not delivered.
outcome: redirect cancelled; home delivery rebooked; delivery pending

title: Recipient wants SMS route notifications enabled on the verified number
boundary: Notifications go to the verified number only; a notification is not an arrival-time guarantee.
outcome: notifications enabled; delivery pending

title: Recipient wants to collect from the depot counter today by appointment
boundary: An appointment is not a collection; the stated identification requirement applies.
outcome: counter appointment booked; collection pending

title: Business consignee changes the receiving dock for tomorrow's pallet before loading
boundary: A dock change is a booking amendment; unloading conditions are assessed on arrival.
outcome: booking amended to the new dock; delivery pending

title: Recipient asks for the collection reference to be re-sent to the verified email
boundary: Re-sending goes only to the verified email on the order; a reference is not a collection.
outcome: reference re-sent; collection pending

title: Recipient asks whether Saturday delivery is possible and what it costs
boundary: Quote before changing; the desk does not set prices; acceptance must come in the verified thread.
outcome: Saturday slot and charge accepted and booked; delivery pending

title: Business sender asks the price and earliest date for a next-day pallet collection
boundary: No booking change until the sender accepts the quoted charge in the verified thread.
outcome: quote accepted and collection booked; collection pending

title: Recipient asks whether the parcel can be redirected to another city and at what cost
boundary: Eligibility and charge come only from routing; no redirect until the recipient accepts.
outcome: redirect accepted and applied; delivery pending at the new address

title: Recipient asks what hold options beyond three days exist and whether storage is charged
boundary: Only the depot quotes storage terms; no hold applied until the recipient accepts.
outcome: extended hold accepted and applied; release pending

title: Reschedule request timed out in the dispatch system and the recipient asks whether it is booked
boundary: Check the saved booking before resubmitting; a timeout is not proof that the change failed; no duplicate booking.
outcome: dispatch confirms the change was applied once; no second change

title: Hold request email bounced and the depot status is unclear
boundary: Verify the stock record first; resubmit only if the hold is confirmed absent.
outcome: hold found absent, then applied once; release pending

title: Pickup-point portal showed an error after the extension was submitted
boundary: Ask the operator what its record shows; do not submit a second extension blindly.
outcome: operator confirms the extension was recorded once; collection pending

title: Routing never acknowledged a redirect and the depot scan is ambiguous
boundary: Determine the actual parcel state before any new instruction; in transit is not arrived.
outcome: parcel confirmed in transit to the pickup point; no second redirect

title: Recipient reports that the delivery van damaged a garden fence
action_to: Safety incident queue, Plover Arc Logistics
boundary: Register the report with facts and the exact question; registration is not a liability or compensation decision.
outcome: incident registered with a reference and next update time; decision pending

title: Recipient insists on delivery today and no policy option exists
action_to: Operations supervisor queue, Plover Arc Logistics
boundary: Promise the customer nothing; queue acceptance is not a decision.
outcome: queue accepts the case with a decision deadline; outcome pending

title: Two people claim the same parcel and the account name does not match the order
boundary: No handover to either claimant; opening a verification case is not a finding.
outcome: parcel held; verification case opened; handover pending

title: Depot flags a missing hazardous-goods label on a parcel containing a battery
boundary: The desk cannot lift a compliance hold; registration is not clearance.
outcome: compliance review registered; hold remains; delivery pending

title: Recipient has not chosen a slot for two days and the offer expires today
boundary: One reminder on the verified channel stating the deadline and the consequence dispatch stated; no booking without a choice.
outcome: reminder sent and deadline recorded; recipient chooses before expiry; slot booked

title: Pickup-point operator has not answered an extension request and the deadline is tomorrow
boundary: One chase stating the expiry time; the desk cannot extend on the operator's behalf.
outcome: operator confirms before expiry; collection pending

title: Nominated neighbour has not accepted the handover nomination required before route release
boundary: Tell the recipient what is pending, who must act and by when; the route is not released without acceptance.
outcome: neighbour acceptance received and recorded; delivery pending

title: Recipient asks for the driver's personal phone number
boundary: Decline: personal contact details are never shared; offer the callback instruction instead.
outcome: recipient accepts the callback instruction; it is recorded; arrival pending

title: Recipient asks to change the address to another city after route release
boundary: Decline under the stated policy; offer the permitted alternative (return to sender and reship through the merchant).
outcome: recipient chooses the alternative; return initiated by the merchant separately

title: Recipient asks to leave the parcel with building security that has no registered receiving arrangement
boundary: Decline: handover to an unregistered third party is not permitted; offer a pickup point or a named household nomination.
outcome: recipient picks a permitted option; it is recorded; delivery pending

title: Business sender asks the desk to waive a correctly applied redelivery fee
boundary: The desk does not set or waive prices; a billing dispute is available only if the sender wants one.
outcome: sender opens a billing dispute; no waiver by the desk; redelivery booked unchanged

title: Recipient cancels the reschedule request before dispatch has booked anything
boundary: Record the stop and ask for the current state; the original slot stands only if dispatch confirms nothing changed.
outcome: reschedule withdrawn; original booking confirmed unchanged

title: Merchant cancels the order while a pickup-point redirect is in progress
boundary: Stop new movement; check what was already executed; return instructions are a separate merchant decision.
outcome: redirect halted at the depot; parcel held pending the merchant's return instruction

title: Recipient withdraws a hold request after returning earlier than planned
boundary: Removing the hold returns the parcel to normal routing; it does not set a delivery date.
outcome: hold removed; parcel back in routing; delivery pending

title: Recipient refuses a parcel at the door saying it was not ordered
boundary: Record the refusal with the stated reason; return authorisation is a separate merchant decision; a refusal is not a refund.
outcome: refusal recorded; parcel returned to depot; merchant instruction pending

title: Business receiving desk refuses a pallet with a crushed corner
stage: driver on site with the pallet
boundary: Record the refusal and ask for the driver's damage record; claim and return are separate processes the desk does not open.
outcome: refusal and damage record logged; pallet returned to depot; claim not opened by the desk

title: Recipient wants to refuse a parcel the day after it was handed over
boundary: After handover this is a return request, not a refusal; merchant authorisation is required before any collection.
outcome: return request registered; merchant authorisation pending

title: Recipient refuses one carton of a three-carton order and accepts the other two
boundary: Record the refusal per carton by its own ID; the order is not complete; return of the refused carton is separate.
outcome: two cartons handed over and one refusal recorded; order remains open

title: Recipient sent the same reschedule request by portal and email and dispatch opened two tickets
boundary: Link the second ticket to the first; one booking change only.
outcome: duplicate ticket closed and linked; a single booking change applied

title: Pickup-point operator sees two extension requests for the same parcel
boundary: Confirm one request and withdraw the duplicate; a single permitted extension applies.
outcome: one extension recorded; duplicate withdrawn; collection pending

title: Recipient's partner who is not on the order asks to change the delivery address
boundary: Only the verified recipient can change the address; do not act on the partner's message or disclose order details to them.
outcome: verified recipient confirms the change in the order thread; address updated

title: Business staff member accepts GBP 45.00 extra cost when the recorded authority is GBP 30.00
boundary: Ask the registered signatory; the planner must not allocate beyond the recorded authority.
outcome: signatory approves within a newly recorded limit; service allocated; unloading pending

title: Merchant support agent asks the desk to release a parcel to a new recipient name
boundary: A recipient change needs the merchant's verified order amendment; the desk cannot rename the recipient.
outcome: amendment received through the verified channel; shipment updated; delivery pending

title: Driver record says handed to the recipient but the recipient says a stranger took it in the lobby
boundary: Keep both statements; request the handover evidence; no finding of loss or fault.
outcome: investigation registered with an evidence request; finding pending

title: Depot weight differs from the merchant manifest for the same parcel
boundary: Record the discrepancy; request a verification scan; do not assume tampering or a wrong parcel.
outcome: verification scan recorded; discrepancy explained by packaging; parcel released to routing

title: Merchant email and carrier booking show different delivery dates
boundary: Only the carrier booking record is authoritative; tell the customer neither date as fact until confirmed.
outcome: carrier confirms the booked date; customer informed; delivery pending
